title: Raccoon wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 38,34 62,34' fill='#ffdd33' stroke='#ff9900' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='4' fill='#ff66cc'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='20' r='2' fill='#66ddff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='2' fill='#ff66cc'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='2' fill='#66ddff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='9' fill='#c9c9d6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='9' fill='#c9c9d6'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='5' fill='#8a8aa3'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='5' fill='#8a8aa3'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#c9c9d6'/>
  <!-- dark mask across eyes -->
  <path d='M24 50 Q50 42 76 50 Q72 62 50 62 Q28 62 24 50 Z' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#eeeee9'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='5' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='5' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='51.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='51.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2e2e40'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 70 Q50 75 56 70' fill='none' stroke='#2e2e40' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='65' r='3' fill='#ff99bb'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='65' r='3' fill='#ff99bb'/>
</svg>
